tokens.name: jar-orange
tokens.usage: The brand colour, measured from the logo file. Fills: sign plates, the primary button, quote cards, the app icon. Text on it is on-brand (5.7:1); white on it only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (3.1:1), as the house's signs do.

tokens.name: teak
tokens.usage: The pods' wood, sampled from the locker doors. Wood bands, footers and print backs; text on it is on-wood. As text: on ground and surface in Day only (4.8:1).

tokens.name: teak-deep
tokens.usage: The dorms' wood in lamplight: the website's deep bands (header of the chat window, the footer, the ledger). Rice text on it is 7:1, on-teak-soft 5.3:1, lamplight 5:1.

tokens.name: teak-night
tokens.usage: Teak-deep a shade darker: pressed states and the Evening theme's deep bands.

tokens.name: on-teak-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on teak-deep (5.3:1).

tokens.name: lamplight
tokens.usage: The glow of the alabaster lamps, sampled from the photos. Evening highlights, the focus ring in Evening, a fill behind ink (11.9:1). Never text on Day grounds.

tokens.name: curtain
tokens.usage: The pod curtains' dark weave, from the dorm photos: the ground of the woven bands (under the hero, along the booking ticket and the footer, the hem of the opening splash, the top of guest emails). Evening is a shade under the page so the band still reads as cloth.

tokens.name: thread-gold
tokens.usage: The curtains' gold thread: the woven bands' thread, with jar-orange hearts. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Day: the website's warm off-white. Evening: the clay of a jar in shadow, sampled from the stairwell photo.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, boards, menus, the booking panel: anything that sits on ground. Day matches the white sign boards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around photos. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control (use ink-muted).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ground and surface (Day 16.7:1, Evening 15:1). Day value measured from the sign boards' black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, notes, metadata and control borders on ground and surface (Day 6.4:1, Evening 8.4:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Alias of jar-orange for components: fills only. Move the brand by moving jar-orange.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill, in both themes (5.7:1). Ink on orange is the quote cards' and door letters' pairing.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text: links, the menu's section titles, a rule's heading. Day: jar-orange darkened to 4.6:1 on ground; Evening: jar-orange itself (5.7:1 on ground, 5.2:1 on surface).

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Alias of teak for component fills (footer band, menu back).

tokens.name: on-wood
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a wood fill (5.1:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px, offset 2px, on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on every surface it lands on, brand fills included.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and refusals, always with words and an icon (Day 6.1:1, Evening 7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations ("Your request is sent"), always with words (Day 6:1, Evening 9:1 on surface).

families.brand: Figtree, "Noto Sans Lao", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.zh: "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", Figtree, sans-serif

groups.name: Screen
groups.note: One family, Figtree, the closest free match to the lettering on the house's signs. Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: A calm house in the heart of Vientiane.
styles.usage: The one headline at the top of a page. One per page; 40px/44px under 600px wide.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles below the hero; 30px/38px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Made for a good night’s sleep.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Breakfast is included and served from 8:00 to 10:30.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Check-out is from 8:00 to 11:30. Leaving before 8? Tell the team the night before and they will return your deposit.
styles.usage: Running text. Never below 16px on phones.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Prices per guest per night, breakfast included.
styles.usage: Notes, captions, the small print under a price.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and eyebrow lines, sentence case (never all caps).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The dollar price in PriceTag; set with tabular figures.

groups.name: Signs and print
groups.note: Sizes for an A4 artboard at 96 dpi (794 × 1123 px); scale with the board.

styles.name: sign-letter
styles.usage: The dormitory letter on door plates.

styles.name: sign-title
styles.usage: A board's title, in brand-text on surface or ink on brand.

styles.name: sign-rule
styles.sample: Quiet please from 9 PM to 7 AM.
styles.usage: One rule per line on boards and plates.

styles.name: menu-item
styles.usage: A menu line; its price in the same size at 600.

groups.name: Lao
groups.note: Noto Sans Lao beside Figtree; Lao runs a little larger to match the Latin x-height.

groups.name: Chinese
groups.note: Noto Sans SC from Google Fonts (not shipped: too large); PingFang or YaHei on devices that have them.

styles.name: zh-body
styles.sample: 欢迎来到 House of Jars
styles.usage: Simplified Chinese text and prices for Chinese guests.

spacing.note: 4px base. The logo is drawn on its own grid (12 × 18 units); spacing is the page's.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; between a price and its note.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of a list or menu.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop. Calm needs room: never squeeze this.

radius.note: Square, like the house's plates and boards. The arch is the only curve, and it belongs to the logo and ArchPhoto.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, boards, menus, cards, bands.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Sign plates and buttons: the acrylic's softened edge.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, date fields, the booking panel's fields.

shadow.note: Almost none. Depth comes from material (wood, paper, lamplight), not from floating cards.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: A sign plate or the booking panel lifted off a photo. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a ground-coloured gap, then the focus colour.
